ID: `jado-visual`.

## What it does

Applies the assigned activities in the same context: visual research, art direction and composition. Can specify motion without implementing it. Moodboards and alternatives depend on the assignment.

## When to use it

When the principal or an already active agent needs to apply one or more domain procedures in the same context.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-visual` in Claude Code or `$jado-visual` in Codex. Provide the contract, assigned activities, order, scope and required evidence. Use role procedures without starting other agents.

## What it delivers

- Assigned outcomes with revision, evidence and limitations

## Example

Apply jado-visual in the current context, limited to the assigned activities.

## Prerequisites

- Readable JADO root and tools required by the assigned procedures.

[Open the JADO skill](https://github.com/mattiamichini-design/jado/blob/HEAD/.agents/skills/jado-visual/SKILL.md)
